preconditions.expression: all(line.strip().split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Every line in stdin is non-empty and contains space-separated integers.

preconditions.expression: int(t) == len([line.strip().split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: The first line is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 400) representing the number of test cases, and there are exactly t subsequent lines.
Each test case line contains exactly two integers n and k.

preconditions.expression: all((n & (n - 1)) == 0 and n >= 4 and n <= 65536 for n, k in [[int(x) for x in line.strip().split()] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is a power of 2 (4 ≤ n ≤ 2^16).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= n - 1 for n, k in [[int(x) for x in line.strip().split()] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, k satisfies 0 ≤ k ≤ n - 1.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() == '-1' or (len(stdout_line.strip().split()) == 2 and all(0 <= int(x) < n for x in stdout_line.strip().split())) for stdout_line, (n, k) in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [[int(x) for x in line.strip().split()] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if no solution exists, stdout contains exactly one line '-1'. Otherwise, stdout contains exactly n/2 lines, each with two integers a_i and b_i (0 ≤ a_i, b_i < n).

postconditions.expression: all((set(int(x) for pair in [line.strip().split() for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() != '-1'] for x in pair) == set(range(n))) for stdout_lines, (n, k) in zip([line.strip().split() for line in stdout.splitlines()], [[int(x) for x in line.strip().split()] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case with a solution, every integer from 0 to n-1 appears exactly once across all pairs.

postconditions.expression: all((sum(int(a) & int(b) for a, b in [line.strip().split() for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() != '-1']) == k) for stdout_lines, (n, k) in zip([line.strip().split() for line in stdout.splitlines()], [[int(x) for x in line.strip().split()] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case with a solution, the sum of the bitwise AND of each pair equals k.

postconditions.expression: all((len([line.strip().split() for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() != '-1']) == n // 2) for stdout_lines, (n, k) in zip([line.strip().split() for line in stdout.splitlines()], [[int(x) for x in line.strip().split()] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case with a solution, exactly n/2 pairs are output.
